prompt: Please add the NWB-1110 package to the November billing release (2026.11) as well.

expect.because: Releases_SetContents replaces both routes: the existing package NWB-1103 and the directly carried Portal 2.9.0 must be sent back alongside the new package.
No call may drop what the release already carries, even as a first attempt, and the id is the release UUID rather than its key or label.
Releases_SetContents is a destructive change the server instructions say needs the user's explicit confirmation.

expected: The agent finds release 2026.11 and package NWB-1110 (a package label, not a key) with the list/get tools, reads the release's current contents (package NWB-1103 and the directly carried Northwind Billing Portal 2.9.0), confirms the change with the user, then calls Releases_SetContents with the release UUID, packageIds [NWB-1103, NWB-1110] and versionIds [Portal 2.9.0]. The skill's "Overwrite, not patch" section and the Releases_SetContents description both say anything left out is removed.

prompt: Can you log the 3.5.0 release of the Northwind Billing API in Wayd? We cut it yesterday, the tag went out at 2026-10-16T18:05:00Z. It hasn't gone to production yet.

result.title: Bad Request
result.detail: Versions cannot be cut against this product's type.

expect.because: "3.5.0" names one artifact and a version number, so it is a version; the skill's four-records section calls this the most common error.
The version is recorded against the releasable Northwind Billing API by UUID.
The product line Northwind Billing is not releasable; versions are cut against the service.
The user gave the cut moment; it is sent as the instant reported, on the new version's UUID.
The user said it has not reached production, so it has not shipped.
Cutting is a status change, which needs the user's explicit confirmation.

expected: Despite the word "release", 3.5.0 names one artifact, so the agent records a version: it finds the Northwind Billing API (releasable Service, not the Northwind Billing product line) with Products_GetProducts, calls Versions_Plan with its UUID and "3.5.0", then Versions_Cut on the returned id with cutAt 2026-10-16T18:05:00Z (asking first if it treats the cut as a status change). It does not call Releases_Plan or Versions_MarkReleased. Cited: the skill's "The most common error" note and the Versions_Plan / Versions_Cut descriptions.

prompt: Where did Northwind Billing API 3.3.1 end up? Which environments got it, and did we ever announce it to customers?

expect.because: 3.3.1 has no deployment of its own; it shipped inside package NWB-0912, found from the packages side (containingVersionId) or the release contents.
The package carrying 3.3.1 was deployed to production, so "never deployed" is wrong.
Release 2026.09 announced the package that carried 3.3.1.

expected: The agent finds 3.3.1's UUID, sees Deployments_GetDeployments with versionId return nothing, and — as the skill's Deployments section and "Answering where did this version go?" say — looks from the packages side: ReleasePackages_GetReleasePackages with containingVersionId gives NWB-0912, whose deployments reached stg-us and prd-us, and Releases_GetReleases with containingVersionId gives release 2026.09 (September Billing Update, announced 2026-09-15). It may add from the rollout that production now runs 3.3.2. It writes nothing.
